rationale: Reconnaissance must cover every table and every column, so the narrow defaults are widened. load_tables + schema_summary give the per-table data contract (row counts, column names, dtypes -> data_contract.json). missingness uses scope=all_columns because the task asks for every column of every table and the manifest shows eight medical_claims columns (dx3-dx5, modifier1/2, denial_reason_desc, auth_number, plus partial nulls in drg/poa/revenue_code) that must be listed as entirely empty; top_10 would truncate that list. duplicate_check tests the natural key of all five tables and includes adherence.member_id alongside the composite member_id+therapeutic_class, so the report can show member_id alone is not unique (500 distinct vs 10,627 rows) while the composite is the real key. date_ranges profiles all three medical_claims date columns with consistency_checks=true, since the manifest shows service_date_to and adjudication_date extending past service_date_from and the task explicitly asks whether adjudication precedes service end. join_check verifies all six relationships later tasks depend on: both claims tables and adherence to members, rendering and billing NPI to providers, and pharmacy_npi to providers, which the manifest indicates has no matches (18,310/18,310 unmatched) and must be reported with cardinality, unmatched counts and denominators. write_report includes the two caveats the task requires verbatim (synthetic_data, sample_preview) plus descriptive_only for scope, and turns on show_denominators and cite_artifacts so every rate is numerator/denominator and every number traces to a saved artifact or metrics key.
